name: hackathonkit
description: Hackathon Agent Kit: local MCP capability layer with Normal/Fly routing, document, knowledge, data, timeseries, media, report, evaluation and learning capabilities.

interface.shortDescription: MCP capabilities, skills, evaluation and learning for hackathon builds.
interface.longDescription: Hackathon Agent Kit packages a typed local MCP server, 29 standard-compliant skills, the experimental Fly router, a deterministic evaluation subsystem, durable learnings, session hooks and a staged build planner for hackathon teams working in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use $task-router to select capabilities for this task.
Use $build-planner to plan this build in stages with gates.
Use $judge to score the frozen snapshot with the official rubric.
